dollars.formula: dUSD per 1,000 = dEscalations x c_esc; c_esc = replayed per-entry cost of the escalated tasks from the shared cloud-only log (cache-aware, PF 1 formula with read multiplier 0.05 on 5.5-tier models)

odds_judgement.source: research report 'Win cost where device defaults break' (registered judgement, not a measurement)

E2.cost_formula: usd_per_session = (BOX_USD / (LIFE_Y x 12 x ACTIVE_H_MONTH) + WATTS/1000 x USD_KWH) x t_session_h / p_complete (active-hour basis); full-utilization basis uses LIFE_Y x 8760 h

cost_inputs_defaults.replace_with: measured wall power and duty cycle, actual purchase price

AMD_X1_over_R_session_ratio.band_derivation: upper = point x 1.3 = 3.70; lower = 2.0, the report's replication criterion (wider than point / 1.3 = 2.19)

attribution_X0.statistic: s = ln(t_R / t_X0) / ln(t_R / t_X1) (share of the X1 gain that FA alone gives)
attribution_X0.prediction: s >= 0.5 (FA / memory fit carries most of it)

XPS_u4_over_i8_sessions_per_day_at_4_con.derivation: capacity bound by the resident limit: u4 26,500 / u8 20,000 (e4a22dac / cf3555d5; u8 is the measured 8-bit proxy for the i8 default); band: 1.0 if memory does not bind at the chosen contexts, 1.5 = one extra 8,192-token session in 20,000 vs 26,500

T2S_u4_over_i8_sessions_per_day.derivation: 64 GB never binds; decode-rate gain only, 1.082 at 12,000 (0a55c316 / 29209e26)

cross_device.pattern: large on 16 GB (XPS) and 128 GB (AMD, f16 at 40,960 x sessions), near-null (<= 1.2x) on the 64 GB T2S

accuracy_noninferiority.test: paired, one-sided 95% lower bound of (X - R) pass rate > -0.05
accuracy_noninferiority.prediction: X1 within about 1 point of R (literature: W8A8KV8 within ~1 point, arXiv 2504.04823); X2 (q4_0 KV) gets its own test
